title: Never import `@content` (or content/source) from src/scripts/**: it ships zod and both datasets to every visitor
body: src/scripts/** is the only code bundled for the browser. `@content` resolves to content/source/index.ts -> json-source.ts, which statically imports zod and both datasets: one import from a client module ships them to every visitor. Anything a chapter script prints comes from the page's markup (data-* attributes, text Astro rendered at build time from the dataset and src/lib/landing-copy.ts), as seats.ts does with its lane labels; build-time helpers belong in src/lib/ and are called from .astro frontmatter only. The same goes for src/lib/ci-steps.ts (node:fs) and anything else that reads the file system. It is caught only after `pnpm run build`, by `pnpm run test:bundle` ('no chunk took zod or the dataset to the browser': ZodObject or the person's full name in a chunk), so get it right while editing. (The three.js rules this memory used to carry went with the 3D map, removed 2026-10-29.)
not_derivable: The check fires only after a full build; an agent writing a client module sees no local hint that one import drags the dataset along.
